58863-an-englishwoman-in-the-philippines.title: An Englishwoman In The Philippines
58863-an-englishwoman-in-the-philippines.creator: Unknown
58863-an-englishwoman-in-the-philippines.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. HOUSEKEEPING IN ILOILO Housekeeping. A WASTED LAND The road to Molo. Custom House methods. An unpleasant surprise. Philippine trading firms. An over-zealous law. Scarcity and high prices. Book-learning _versus_ agriculture. CUSTOMS AND DRESS OF THE NATIVES A Filipino _Fiesta_. Doctor Rizal and his work. Dress of the native women. Scrupulous cleanliness. SOCIAL AMUSEMENTS A ball at the Spanish Club. Bringing in the New Year. Position of Eurasians. The suburbs of Iloilo. TARIFFS—INSECTS More Custom House surprises. _Anting-anting._ Snakes. A FILIPINO THEATRE—_CARABAOS_ Dramatic clubs.

arxiv-1510-06165.title: Higgs-Portal Scalar Dark Matter: Scattering Cross Section and Observable Limits
arxiv-1510-06165.creator: Huayong Han, Sibo Zheng
arxiv-1510-06165.description: Abstract Abstract The simplest Higgs-portal dark matter model is studied in the light of dark matter self-interacting effects on the formation of large scale structures. We show the direct detection limits in both the resonant and large mass region. Finally, we also compare these limits with those at the LHC and Xenon 1T experiments.

arxiv-2203-16755.title: Stochastic Backpropagation: A Memory Efficient Strategy for Training Video Models
arxiv-2203-16755.creator: Feng Cheng Mingze Xu Yuanjun Xiong Hao Chen Xinyu Li Wei Li Wei Xia, [.5ex] UNC Chapel Hill AWS AI Labs[.5ex] fengchan@cs.unc.edu, {xumingze,yuanjx,hxen,xxnl,wayl,wxia}@amazon.com
arxiv-2203-16755.description: Abstract We propose a memory efficient method, named Stochastic Backpropagation (SBP), for training deep neural networks on videos. It is based on the finding that gradients from incomplete execution for backpropagation can still effectively train the models with minimal accuracy loss, which attributes to the high redundancy of video.

arxiv-2207-08987.title: Asymmetric Light Bending in the Equatorial Kerr Metric
arxiv-2207-08987.creator: Arthur B. Congdon, Savitri V. Iyer, Charles R. Keeton
arxiv-2207-08987.description: Abstract The observation of the bending of light by mass, now known as gravitational lensing, was key in establishing general relativity as one of the pillars of modern physics. In the past couple of decades, there has been increasing interest in using gravitational lensing to test general relativity beyond the weak deflection limit.

arxiv-2306-12603.title: The Cost of Informing Decision-Makers in Multi-Agent Maximum Coverage Problems with Random Resource Values
arxiv-2306-12603.creator: Bryce L. Ferguson, Dario Paccagnan, and Jason R. Marden
arxiv-2306-12603.description: Abstract The emergent behavior of a distributed system is conditioned by the information available to the local decision-makers. Therefore, one may expect that providing decision-makers with more information will improve system performance; in this work, we find that this is not necessarily the case.

arxiv-2308-01850.title: Synthesizing Long-Term Human Motions with Diffusion Models via Coherent Sampling DOI: 3581783.3611887 1615 CCS: Computing methodologies Activity recognition and understanding
arxiv-2308-01850.creator: Zhao Yang, Bing Su, Ji-Rong Wen
arxiv-2308-01850.description: Abstract . Text-to-motion generation has gained increasing attention, but most existing methods are limited to generating short-term motions that correspond to a single sentence describing a single action. However, when a text stream describes a sequence of continuous motions, the generated motions corresponding to each sentence may not be coherently linked. Existing long-term motion generation methods face two main issues.

arxiv-2408-02870.title: Narrowband Electromagnetic Coupling Matrix in Coupled-Resonator Microwave Circuits
arxiv-2408-02870.creator: Valentín de la Rubia, David Young
arxiv-2408-02870.description: Abstract A novel methodology to unleash electromagnetic coupling matrix information in coupled-resonator microwave circuits has been recently proposed [ 1 ] . This information is derived from Maxwell’s equations and the natural language of electromagnetics is employed. As a result, the coupling matrix coefficients stand only for electromagnetics.

arxiv-2507-22759.title: Scalar tidal response of static and rotating black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime
arxiv-2507-22759.creator: Yusmantoro, Freddy Permana Zen, Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi
arxiv-2507-22759.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the tidal response of both static and rotating black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime. We perform the neutral scalar field perturbation for Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes. On the other hand, charged scalar field are used for perturbing Reissner-Nordstrom and Kerr-Newman black holes.

pmc-11615828.title: Precise Control of Intracellular Trafficking and Receptor‐Mediated Endocytosis in Living Cells and Behaving Animals
pmc-11615828.creator: Shiau‐Chi Chen, Neng‐Jie Zeng, Grace Y. Liu, Hsien‐Chu Wang, Tzu‐Ying Lin, Yi‐Ling Tai, Chiao‐Yun Chen, Yin Fang, Yi‐Chien Chuang, Ching‐Lin Kao, Hsuan Cheng, Bing‐Huang Wu, Pin‐Chiao Sun, Odvogmed Bayansan, Yu‐Ting Chiu, Chi‐Hsuan Shih, Wen‐Hong Chung, Jia‐Bin Yang, Lily Hui‐Ching Wang, Po‐Han Chia
pmc-11615828.description: Intracellular trafficking, an extremely complex network, dynamically orchestrates nearly all cellular activities. A versatile method that enables the manipulation of target transport pathways with high spatiotemporal accuracy in vitro and in vivo is required to study how this network coordinates its functions. Here, a new method called RIVET (Rapid Immobilization of target Vesicles on Engaged Tracks) is presented.

pmc-11637514.title: Cardiorenal effects of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors and angiotensin receptor blockers among people underrepresented in trials: analysis of routinely collected data with emulation of a reference trial (ONTARGET)
pmc-11637514.creator: Paris J Baptiste, Angel Y S Wong, Anna Schultze, Catherine M Clase, Clémence Leyrat, Elizabeth Williamson, Emma Powell, Johannes F E Mann, Marianne Cunnington, Koon Teo, Shrikant I Bangdiwala, Peggy Gao, Laurie Tomlinson, Kevin Wing
pmc-11637514.description: Cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death globally. Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEi) and angiotensin receptor blockers (ARB), compared in the ONTARGET trial (Ongoing Telmisartan Alone and in Combination with Ramipril Global Endpoint Trial), each prevent cardiovascular disease. However, trial results may not be generalizable, and their effectiveness in underrepresented groups is unclear.

pmc-11646468.title: Sebaceous Carcinoma in the Right Inguinal Region with Multiple Metastases and a Poor Prognosis: A Case Report
pmc-11646468.creator: Qian Gao, Yuanhong Lin, Yan Du, Chi Du
pmc-11646468.description: IntroductionSebaceous carcinoma (SC) is a rare malignancy and can be divided into two types, ocular and extra-ocular SC. Extra-ocular SC is typically associated with a better prognosis than ocular SC. However, extra-ocular SCs located in atypical areas, such as the inguinal region, along with multiple metastases, are uncommon and present significant challenges, often leading to poorer outcomes.

pmc-12567867.title: Health System Determinants of Delivery and Uptake of HPV Vaccination Services Among Involuntary Migrant Populations: A Qualitative Systematic Review
pmc-12567867.creator: Jennifer Nyawira Githaiga, Jill Olivier, Susanne Noll, Edina Amponsah-Dacosta, Ahmad Reza Hosseinpoor, Devaki Nambiar, Nicole Bergen, M Carolina Danovaro, Hope L Johnson, Ibrahim Dadari
pmc-12567867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Migrant populations are commonly under-immunised relative to general populations in host countries. The evidence base on routine vaccination among migrant children suggests that higher priority is given to infants and younger children compared to adolescents. Though migrants are often classified as a homogenous group, different sub-populations of migrants exist, including voluntary migrants who choose to move and involuntary migrants forcibly displaced by humanitarian crises.

pmc-12609563.title: Climate Change Projected Effects on Hamatocaulis vernicosus Occurrence in Romania
pmc-12609563.creator: Sorin Ștefănuț, Claudia Biță-Nicolae, Tiberiu Sahlean, Constantin-Ciprian Bîrsan, Ioana Cătălina Paica, Georgiana-Roxana Nicoară, Florența-Elena Helepciuc, Miruna-Maria Ștefănuț, Ana-Maria Moroșanu
pmc-12609563.description: Hamatocaulis vernicosus is a pleurocarpous moss of conservation concern, listed in Annex II of the EU Habitats Directive due to its significant and ongoing decline across Europe. H. vernicosus is also listed as ‘Vulnerable’ on the Red List of Romanian Bryophytes.

pmc-12627813.title: Numerical analysis of dynamic behavior of falling rock block impact against soil-rock mixture by coupling DEM-FDM approach
pmc-12627813.creator: Yulong Zhang, Qiwen Guo, Haixia Zhang, Yuhan Wang, Xin Wang, Xin Zhang
pmc-12627813.description: Rockfall, as a common geological hazard, exhibits extremely complex impact dynamic behaviors that are significantly influenced by factors like the impact falling height and the composition of soil layers. To this end, this paper initially establishes a three-dimensional impact model of falling rock based on the DEM-FDM, which takes into account the near-field impact effect.

pmc-12686540.title: Inverse In2O3-x/Ni interfaces via Ni3InC0.5 surface reconstruction for efficient CO2 hydrogenation to methanol
pmc-12686540.creator: Jiyi Chen, Tiantian Xiao, Bingqing Yao, Maoshuai Li, Heng Zhang, Mingwu Tan, Shibo Xi, Shixiong Tang, Wenyan Jia, Qi Yang, Ziwen Hao, Zhenmei Zhang, Kang Hui Lim, Xiaoyu Han, Xiaohui Zi, Yue Wang, Jing Lv, Qian He, Yong Wang, Sibudjing Kawi, Xinbin Ma
pmc-12686540.description: Catalyst surface reconstruction under reaction conditions is ubiquitous and crucial for creating unusual active sites, thereby enhancing catalytic performance. Here, we report the surface reconstruction of supported Ni3InC0.5 nanoparticles, leading to the formation of defective In2O3-x overlayers and inverse In2O3-x/Ni interfaces, driven by CO2-induced selective surface oxidation during CO2 hydrogenation.

pmc-12846344.title: Potential of Bovine Herpesvirus Vectors for Recombinant Vaccines
pmc-12846344.creator: Eda Mert Gokduman, Mustafa Ozan Atasoy, Ayşe Gencay Goksu, İbrahim Sozdutmaz, Muhammad Munir
pmc-12846344.description: The livestock industry experiences significant economic losses as a result of viral infections. Building on recent advances in biotechnological research, recombinant viral vector vaccines have emerged as promising platforms for next-generation vaccines. These vaccines can overcome many limitations of conventional vaccines, as they provide stronger protective immune profiles, stability, and improved safety profiles for various diseases.

pmc-13234117.title: Advantages of magnetic compression in rat colonic anastomosis: a comparative study with a transcriptomic perspective
pmc-13234117.creator: Shuqin Xu, Long Liu, Linbiao Xiang, Jiaru Xu, Yuning Shao, Chentao Li, Yuebing Han, Yaoxing Ren, Miaomiao Zhang, Nan Li, Juanjuan Wang, Xiaopeng Yan, Yi Lyu
pmc-13234117.description: Colorectal anastomosis is a common procedure in colorectal cancer surgery, but traditional suturing is technically demanding and prone to complications. Magnetic compression anastomosis (MCA) offers a simpler, minimally invasive alternative with favorable outcomes. This study compares the healing effects of MCA and conventional suturing in rat colonic anastomosis and investigates the molecular mechanisms involved.

pmc-13300140.title: Targeting slow conduction areas in the cavo-tricuspid isthmus to reduce ablation burden in typical atrial flutter: a multicentre randomized trial
pmc-13300140.creator: G Garosi, J Jimenez-Lopez, C E Gonzalez Matos, B J Casteigt, P V Falzone, G Guelfand Crignola, E Valles-Gras
pmc-13300140.description: BackgroundDuring typical atrial flutter (AFL) the cavo-tricuspid isthmus (CTI) exhibits conduction delay, which enables the perpetuation of the reentrant circuit. A new ablation strategy targeting only slow conduction areas has achieved CTI block in 92% of patients, suggesting these regions as preferential targets.

pmc-13471325.title: Neuromodulation by electrical stimulation timing during picture naming task based on high gamma dynamics
pmc-13471325.creator: Kyousuke Kamada, Christoph Kapeller, Mostafa Mohammadpour, Johannes Gruenwald, Christoph Guger

pmc-13503208.title: From living metaphors in impactful dreams to sublime disquietude and sublime enthrallment
pmc-13503208.creator: Don Kuiken, Ming-Ni Lee
pmc-13503208.description: IntroductionThe continuing impact of spontaneously recalled dreams sometimes depends upon the same kind of unfolding semantic complexity that literary scholars attribute to poetic literary metaphors.MethodsWe present the results of two online studies of impactful dreams (i.e., nightmares, existential dreams, and transcendent dreams) that reinforce this account.

pmc-13504476.title: EMS blood coordinators: core to the mission of saving lives with prehospital blood transfusion
pmc-13504476.creator: Timothy Chizmar
pmc-13504476.description: e death after injury in the USA.2 Furthermore, recent data have shown a 2% increase in the odds of 24-hour and 30-day mortality for every 1-minute delay in prehospital resuscitation for blunt and penetrating trauma patients.3 There is also recent evidence that earlier transfusion of whole blood is associated with improved odds of survival at 24 hours and 30 days.

pmc-13518824.title: Environmental DNA from pumped deep-sea water enables monitoring of deep-sea fish diversity
pmc-13518824.creator: Takao Yoshida, Masaru Kawato, Shinji Tsuchida, Aya Yamazaki, Yoshihiro Fujiwara, Yuriko Nagano, Akinori Yabuki
pmc-13518824.description: Monitoring deep-sea biodiversity is challenging because conventional methods, such as net-sampling and visual surveys, require substantial logistical effort. Environmental DNA (eDNA) offers an alternative for detecting marine organisms; however, its application in deep-sea ecosystems is limited by the sampling accessibility.
